question: In Fresenius SE & Co. KGaA's consolidated segment reporting for 2025 (figures excluding the discontinued Fresenius Vamed operations), which of the three reporting columns - Fresenius Kabi, Fresenius Helios and Corporate / Other - reported the highest EBIT, and what were the EBIT values of all three?
reference_answer: Fresenius Kabi reported the highest EBIT in 2025: €1,413 million (before special items), ahead of Fresenius Helios at €1,328 million (before special items); Corporate / Other had EBIT of -€431 million (after special items). Group EBIT was €2,310 million.

question: Rank Fresenius SE & Co. KGaA's three reporting segments (Fresenius Kabi, Fresenius Helios, Corporate / Other) by number of employees at the balance sheet date of December 31, 2025, and give the headcount of each.
reference_answer: 1) Fresenius Helios: 130,240 employees; 2) Fresenius Kabi: 40,913; 3) Corporate / Other: 7,241 (Fresenius Group total: 178,394), per capita on the balance sheet date.

question: Was Fresenius Group's EBIT margin before special items higher in 2025 than in 2024 (consolidated, excluding the discontinued Fresenius Vamed operations)?
reference_answer: No. The Fresenius Group EBIT margin before special items was 11.5% in 2025, slightly below 11.6% in 2024 (a decline of 0.1 percentage point), even though Group EBIT rose from €2,073 million to €2,310 million.
